description:
University Management Timetable & Scheduling System API

## System contract boundaries

This document is the comprehensive contract overview for UMTAS. Entries under **Paths** are callable HTTP operations. Queue and CLI payloads are documented under **Schemas** and are not HTTP endpoints.

| Boundary | Transport | Contract schemas |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Next.js frontend → NestJS backend | HTTP | Paths and HTTP DTO schemas |
| NestJS backend → PDF parser worker | BullMQ `pdf.parse` | `Queue_PdfParseJob` |
| PDF parser worker → NestJS backend | HTTP callback | `Http_PdfParserCallback`, `Worker_PdfParserResult` |
| NestJS backend → solver worker | BullMQ `timetable.solve` | `Queue_TimetableSolveJob` |
| NestJS backend → solver worker | Internal HTTP | `Worker_SolverInput` |
| Solver worker → NestJS backend | HTTP callback | `Http_SolverCallback`, `Worker_SolverResult` |
| Solver worker ↔ native solver | CLI and JSON files | `Cli_SolverInput`, `Cli_SolverOutput` |

Cross-field rules described on schemas are enforced by the runtime Zod contracts in `packages/shared-types`; OpenAPI documents those rules but cannot enforce all relational constraints.

Queue_PdfParseJob.description: BullMQ job payload sent by the NestJS backend to the PDF parser worker on the `pdf.parse` queue. Runtime authority: `PdfParseJobDataSchema` in `packages/shared-types/src/parser.ts`.

Queue_TimetableSolveJob.description: BullMQ job payload sent by the NestJS backend to the solver worker on the `timetable.solve` queue. Runtime authority: `TimetableSolveJobDataSchema` in `packages/shared-types/src/solver.ts`.

Worker_PdfParserResult.description: Structured parser result produced by the PDF parser worker. Every event is either recurring (`isRecurring: true`, `day` set, `date: null`) or dated (`isRecurring: false`, `date` set, `day: null`). Runtime rule: `startTime` must be earlier than `endTime`.

Worker_SolverInput.description: Scheduling problem and preferences returned by the backend to the solver worker and written as the native solver input JSON file. Each scheduling event must contain exactly one of `date` or `dayOfWeek`, and `startTime` must be earlier than `endTime`.

Worker_SolverResult.description: Normalized solver result returned by the solver worker. Runtime rules: `metadata.conflictCount` equals `metadata.conflicts.length`; `outcome` is `conflict-free` when the count is zero and `best-effort` otherwise.

Http_PdfParserCallback.description: Discriminated HTTP callback sent by the PDF parser worker. A completed callback contains only `status` and `result`; a failed callback contains only `status` and `error`.

Http_SolverCallback.description: Discriminated HTTP callback sent by the solver worker. A completed callback contains only `status` and `result`; a failed callback contains only `status` and `error`.

Cli_SolverInput.description: JSON file passed to the native solver with `--input`. Its content is the solver input retrieved from the backend.

Cli_SolverOutput.description: JSON file written by the native solver to the `--output` path. Runtime authority: `SolverCliOutputSchema` in `packages/shared-types/src/solver.ts`. A successful process writes exactly one of the feasible or infeasible shapes.
